description: This file defines data transfer object (DTO) records related to outage management, including LocationDto, CustomerDto, CrewDto, OutageDto, JobDto, and various request and event DTOs used in the outage management and dispatch platform.

classes.name: LocationDto
classes.description: DTO representing location details including address and coordinates.

classes.name: JobDto
classes.description: DTO representing job details related to outages.

classes.name: JobStatusEventDto
classes.description: DTO representing status change events for jobs.

classes.name: OutageUpdateDto
classes.description: DTO representing updates made to outages.

classes.name: CreateOutageRequest
classes.description: Request DTO for creating a new outage, including location details.

classes.name: UpdateOutageStatusRequest
classes.description: Request DTO for updating the status of an outage.

classes.name: AddOutageNoteRequest
classes.description: Request DTO for adding a note to an outage.

classes.name: CreateJobRequest
classes.description: Request DTO for creating a new job related to an outage.

classes.name: AssignJobRequest
classes.description: Request DTO for assigning a job to a crew or user.

classes.name: UpdateJobStatusRequest
classes.description: Request DTO for updating the status of a job.
